description: Implementation of the base Direct3D renderer for ANGLE, including device management, capabilities, and rendering logic.

classes.name: RendererD3D
classes.description: Implements the Direct3D renderer, managing device state, capabilities, and rendering operations.

methods.name: RendererD3D
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with a display reference.

methods.name: ~RendererD3D
methods.description: Destructor for RendererD3D.

methods.name: skipDraw
methods.description: Determines whether to skip drawing based on current state and mode.

methods.name: getResetStatus
methods.description: Checks and returns the current graphics reset status.

methods.name: notifyDeviceLost
methods.description: Notifies the display that the device was lost.

methods.name: getVendorString
methods.description: Returns a string identifying the GPU vendor.

methods.name: setGPUDisjoint
methods.description: Sets the disjoint flag indicating GPU disjoint status.

methods.name: getGPUDisjoint
methods.description: Returns and clears the GPU disjoint flag.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns a timestamp; always 0 as D3D cannot reliably provide it.

methods.name: ensureCapsInitialized
methods.description: Initializes renderer capabilities if not already done.

methods.name: getNativeCaps
methods.description: Returns the native capabilities of the renderer.

methods.name: getNativeTextureCaps
methods.description: Returns the native texture capabilities.

methods.name: getNativeExtensions
methods.description: Returns the native extensions supported.

methods.name: getNativeLimitations
methods.description: Returns the limitations of the renderer.

methods.name: generateSerial
methods.description: Generates a new serial number for renderer operations.

methods.name: InstancedPointSpritesActive
methods.description: Checks if instanced point sprites are active for a given program and mode.

methods.name: initRenderTarget
methods.description: Initializes a render target with a clear color.

methods.name: getFeatures
methods.description: Returns the features supported by the renderer.

methods.name: GetBlendSampleMask
methods.description: Calculates the sample mask for blending based on current state.

methods.name: DefaultGLErrorCode
methods.description: Maps HRESULT error codes to OpenGL error enums.
